description: Read the CONTENT of one AI package resource of a video in one language: the quiz questions and options (correct ones marked) and its options, the mind map topics, or the eBook cover, style and chapters (with `chapter`, that chapter's text; the whole text when short). Also says whether the resource can be edited (legacy = generated by the old package, not editable; uploaded PDF eBook = no content). Read-only. Use before panda_update_ai_resource. To list which resources a video has use panda_get_videos_ai_resources.

chapter.description: eBook only: chapter number whose text to return

lang.description: Language of the resource, e.g. 'en'. Default: the only one, else the video's language

name: panda_get_ai_resource_content
title: Get AI Resource Content
